stories.title: Implement NOSS CoCU Related Knowledge Dependency Mapper
stories.description: Build automated tool that validates every Related Knowledge item in NOSS CoCU has supporting KP (knowledge paper) content, generating comprehensive coverage audit report.
acceptanceCriteria: Create script scripts/validate_rk_coverage.py that reads prd.json RelatedKnowledge arrays for all 3 subjects and scans for corresponding KP files with matching RK reference codes
Generate audit report listing: (1) covered RK items with file paths, (2) missing KP files (orphaned RK), (3) KP files without CoCU reference (undocumented content)
Exit code 0 for 100% coverage, non-zero with stderr warnings for partial coverage; designed for CI/CD integration
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/validate_rk_coverage.py (main), scripts/rk_parser.py (utility)
Test command: uv run python scripts/validate_rk_coverage.py bev aesthetic it && uv run pytest tests/test_rk_dependency_mapper.py -v
Use JSON schema validation for prd.json RelatedKnowledge structure

stories.title: Implement Training Hours Distribution Validator for 30/70 Knowledge/Performance Split
stories.description: Automated tool ensuring lesson plan allocations comply with mandatory 30% knowledge-based / 70% performance-based training hour distribution across all CUs.
acceptanceCriteria: Create script scripts/validate_training_distribution.py that parses all PM-teori.md and PM-amali.md files, extracts duration hours from header metadata, calculates K/P split per CU

stories.title: Implement WIM Document Structure Validator for Consistency Across All Subjects
stories.description: Automated tool validating all WIM documents follow required JPK Buku Panduan WIM structure (TAJUK/TUJUAN/PENERANGAN, BAHAGIAN sections, LANGKAH KERJA tables, SENARAI SEMAK checklists).

stories.title: Build Assessment Question Progression Analyzer with Difficulty Level Distribution
stories.description: Tool analyzing Bloom's taxonomy cognitive level distribution across all KA/PA questions to ensure balanced progression from basic recall to advanced synthesis.
acceptanceCriteria: Create script scripts/analyze_question_progression.py that reads all KA/PA files, extracts Bloom's level tags (L1-L6) from question metadata, generates per-subject and per-CU distribution histograms

Output: distribution percentages (L1% | L2% | L3% | L4% | L5% | L6%), identify imbalance patterns with specific examples, generate recommendations for question rebalancing with CU+question ID suggestions
Integrate health check into .spiral monitoring to track if assessment progression drifts from target 20-20-20-20-15-5 distribution
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/analyze_question_progression.py with Bloom's level extraction from question metadata
Test command: uv run python scripts/analyze_question_progression.py bev && uv run pytest tests/test_question_progression_analyzer.py -v
Validate distribution percentages sum to 100% and flag outlier questions
